rendered:
According to the US Advanced Battery Consortium standards, an EV battery reaches the end of its usable life when its current capacity is less than 80%[1] of the rated capacity.[2][3][4]

Once they reach that point, end-of-life EV batteries can be reused or repurposed (for example for grid energy storage or behind-the-meter storage), recycled, or disposed of in landfills, which the review says would cause serious environmental issues.[5][6][7]

The review says that all of these batteries eventually need to be recycled, regardless of whether they are reused first.[8][9]
